name: GetManyAccounts
label: Get Multiple Salesforce Accounts
description: Retrieves multiple Account records from Salesforce using SOQL query.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Account'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'Query'.

fields.name: SoqlQuery
fields.label: SOQL Query
fields.description: The SOQL query to execute (e.g., SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'Test%').

fields.name: AccountsData
fields.label: Accounts Data
fields.description: The list of Account records returned as JSON array.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
